reviews.text: I have been going to this vet for over 5 years now and definitely recommend them to anyone seeking a great vet for their pet. The vet is exceptional and the staff truly care about my pet and his well being.

I took my cat Negri there and they treated her wonderfully. They were very kind, patient, and careful with her, as she usually gets nervous. They explained everything clearly, and it's obvious they truly care about animals. Thank you for treating Negri so well.

We have been taking Michelob since we got him at 3 months old. He is turning 6 yrs in October and we take him every year for his annual check ups. We have had 2 incidents that have required special care and Dr Garcia and his staff have taken excellent care of Mic. Both serious situations and they were great with him and the after care also good. Our Mic is healthy and happy. We are very happy with Westwood Vet Clinic. Trust the Dr and the staff 100%.

First of all, I'm so happy to hear that Churry's surgery went well!

I want to express my sincerest gratitude to the entire team at this veterinary clinic for the excellent work, dedication, and care they showed my beloved Churry.

Yesterday, my pet underwent surgery that, thanks to the professional hands of surgeon Canaval and Dr. Eduardo García, along with the entire team at this clinic, was a complete success. But beyond the surgery, I want to highlight the constant follow-up, attention, patience, and commitment they have demonstrated at every stage of my Pekingese's illness over these past three and a half months.

It's such a relief to know that my dog ​​has been and continues to be in such good hands. Thank you for taking care of her as if she were part of your own family.

With all my love and gratitude,
Churry's Family 🐾❤️

Thanks to Dr. Eduardo Garcia of Westwood Veterinary Clinic in Westchester, Miami, thank you for your support, patience, and for giving Nalita such compassionate care. My kitten's spaying went perfectly! 🥰 She was back to her normal life within days. 🤗 Thank you, Eduardo. Our family is incredibly grateful for your professionalism and the love you give to animals. I highly recommend him.
Super nice and Helpful staff.

Excellent service/bedside manners from Dr GARCIA and his entire staff (Aimee, Ashley, Sara, Maria, and 2 techs) He now tends to both my dogs as well as both of my mother’s dogs as well.  Kudos and accolades to WESTWOOD VET…eternally grateful we will be.
Dr. Eduardo Díaz and his entire team are excellent. I have complete confidence in this clinic.
The service is excellent.
Excellent service and quality. Very professional.
Thank God and this vet, my baby is safe and sound.

Excellent Care at Westwood Veterinary Clinic - Westchester

I can't thank Dr. Eduardo García and technician Miguel at Westwood Veterinary Clinic enough. I took my dog ​​in for an emergency with terrible acute diarrhea, and it turned out to be pancreatitis. Another clinic told me he needed to be hospitalized for 24 hours in the emergency room, which I couldn't afford.

Dr. García saw me immediately and created an outpatient plan: I brought him in the morning, he stayed with them all day, they administered his IV medications, including Panoquel CA1, which the other clinic didn't have, and I picked him up in the afternoon. That medication was key to his recovery.

They handle urgent cases and some emergencies, and they have a full lab at the clinic, so results are available immediately. My dog ​​recovered very well thanks to them.

If you live in Westchester or Miami and need an honest, competent, and truly caring veterinarian, go to Westwood Veterinary Clinic. I highly recommend them.

Traveling to Hawaii with pets is a headache because of the rabies titer and quarantine, but Westwood Veterinary Clinic in Westchester, Miami, makes it easy. DVM Eduardo García, certified in therapeutic nutrition management, saw me after being referred by another client.

First, he performed an incredibly thorough physical exam for my dog's obesity and identified the real cause. Then he put together my entire Hawaii itinerary: dates for the rabies antibody titer, the USDA-signed international travel health certificate, and even the respiratory ZPCR test required by Hawaiian Airlines.

They use an in-house lab for urgent matters and external reference labs at competitive rates for the FAVN titer. Thanks to them, my dog ​​can enter Hawaii without the 120-day quarantine. If you're going to Hawaii, don't waste your time elsewhere.
We had the best experience with COCOA
They're the best in Miami, I've been with them for years
The best clinic, the best staff, and the doctor is definitely the best in Miami. I've been bringing my three dogs here for years, and I highly recommend it.
Very good doctors and very good care.

Simply wonderful! I have six dogs; four of them have been treated at Westwood Veterinary Clinic for as long as I can remember, and a fifth one started today. The care provided—from the front desk staff to the veterinary nurses and the entire team—is truly incredible. Dr. Eduardo Garcia is on a whole other level: professional, incredibly knowledgeable, dedicated, and deeply caring. He is absolutely the person I trust most to treat my dogs; whatever he explains to me or recommends for them is gospel. On one occasion, he saved three puppies—barely three weeks old and in critical condition—and they all pulled through. He attended to them immediately, treated them with masterful skill, and called me every single day to monitor their progress and adjust their treatments. Today, all three are alive and happy (two of them are still with me). In short, I couldn't recommend a better place; take your dogs to Westwood Veterinary Clinic, and you will never regret it. Thank you to everyone—and a special thank you to Dr. Eduardo Garcia for taking such good care of my "children" and for having the patience to deal with their parents!

Wonderful! I have six dogs, and four of them have been treated at Westwood Veterinary Clinic since they were born, and another one started today. The service is incredible, from the front desk staff to the nurses and all the other personnel. Dr. Eduardo Garcia is on another level—professional, incredibly knowledgeable, dedicated, and caring. He's definitely the one I trust to treat my dogs. What he explains and tells me to do is law. Once, he saved three puppies, just three weeks old, from critical condition. They pulled through. He treated them the same day, providing masterful care, and called me daily to check on their progress and adjust their treatments. Today, all three are alive and happy (two with me). In short, I have no better place to recommend. Take your dogs to Westwood Veterinary Clinic, and you'll never regret it. Thank you all, and thank you, Dr. Eduardo Garcia, for taking care of my dogs and for being so patient with their parents!

Excellent service for international travel health certificates!
I traveled to Colombia with my dog ​​Kayro, and Dr. Eduardo García at Westwood Veterinary Clinic in Westchester, Miami, was impeccable. Dr. García is a USDA-accredited DVM, and that makes all the difference. I needed a rabies vaccination recertification for reentry to the USA, the new document required to return to the US after traveling abroad to countries on the high-risk rabies list, such as Colombia, and they handled it perfectly.

They also offer digital signatures for the certificate from the USDA for countries that accept them, which speeds everything up. I had no problems with the airline or with the Colombian or US health authorities. The process was quick, clear, and professional. 100% recommended for USDA procedures and international travel with pets.

5 stars for Dr. Eduardo García at Westwood Veterinary Clinic in Westchester, Miami. My 4-month-old puppy had diarrhea for weeks, and no treatment was working. I came for a second opinion, and it was the best decision.

He reviewed her complete history, ruled out parvovirus and giardia with antigen tests and a fecal exam for internal parasites. Everything came back negative. Instead of continuing to medicate blindly, he designed a special dietary plan for her age and adjusted the treatment.

In 2 days, the diarrhea stopped, and she's already regained the 2 pounds she had lost. Dr. García explains the causes, gives you options, and doesn't make you spend money on unnecessary tests. For puppies with gastrointestinal problems in Miami, they are the best.
I trust the doctor with both my babies.  He saved my Yorkie when she ate a stick.  The best!
Good place! The vet is good and nice
Best vet ever!
Excellent service and experience. Doctor Garcia is very knowledgeable and helpful every time I bring my dog. I highly recommend this place.
Excellent service
Dr Garcia. Is very thorough and professional and also his assistant

We have been bringing our dogs here for the last 20 years. They cared for our Shitzu  for 14 years, always with utmost professionalism and most importantly a great deal of love. Now with our rescue mixed breed the excellent care and dedication has continued. We are ever so grateful and pleased. Highly recommended.
Excellent, the best veterinarian ever!

we looooove the Vet. He is caring, detailed, knowledgeable, and truly loves each dog. The clinic is clean, The staff is friendly. I trust taking my furry friends there and we feel safe knowing they are in the best hands ever!!

I recently adopted a beagle puppy that had some respiratory issues and ever since I took her to see Dr. Garcia, she done a complete 180! My two baby girls are super healthy and attended to because of the vet tech team at Westwood! I would highly recommend them
Great service very kind and understanding. Didn’t judge me for not bringing my dog in for a while
Excellent service and attention, they treat your dogs like family ❤️

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating, Massiel. We appreciate your support and look forward to serving you again. If there is anything we can do to make your next visit even better, please let us know.
Excellent service

Excellent experience at Westwood Veterinary Clinic. From the moment you walk in, you notice the excellent service: the team is friendly, patient, and takes the time to explain everything. What I value most is the availability of diagnostic techniques all in one place—X-rays, lab work, and ultrasound—which greatly expedited my dog's diagnosis. We left with a clear plan, and he's already doing much better.

Great experience at Westwood Veterinary Clinic.

The staff gave us amazing care—kind, professional, and they explained everything clearly.

I also loved that they have in-house diagnostic tools like X-rays, blood work, and ultrasound, so we got answers quickly.
The best veterinarian. 100% recommended.

Great people and good at what they do! They’ve taken care of my dogs and cats throughout the 10 plus years that my family and I have seen them. They have always been good with their services and informative feedback. Truly a great place to take your pets for proper/reliable treatment and care overall! 👍 …
excelent services 17 years taking care of my dog
The staff and doctor are very attentive and they took great care of my little Lila, I recommend coming to this vet clinic anyday

Dr. Garcia has been seeing my beautiful Gála (female min. Schnauzer) ever since she was 6 months old.  She's now eight years old and I will not change him ever for any other Vet. He's extremely knowledgeable,  professional and caring, to say the least. His staff is awesome as well.  Always pleasant and willing to help. I highly recommend him. He's the Best of the Best. Thank you Dr. Garcia for the care and dedication you have given Gála throughout all these years. ❤️ 🐕♥️

I love the way Westwood veterinary clinic is. I was recommended by my brother who has been taking his two dogs here for years and it was the best choice I could’ve made as a new pet owner. The way they treat the animals is second to none and you could see the love they have for the pets. Doctor Garcia is the best! He is not only a vet, he is a friend and loves animals. He treats them as if they were his own and it is comforting to see that. It definitely makes me feel good knowing my pet is in good hands. I 100% recommend this vet.
An amazing place, they treat our pets with love and patience 😻.

I’ve had a really good experience with Westwood Veterinary Clinic. The staff is friendly, patient, and you can tell they truly care about the animals. They answered my questions, didn’t make me feel rushed, and treated my pet with a lot of kindness. The clinic is clean and organized, and the whole visit felt smooth from start to finish. If you’re in the Westchester area and need a vet, I definitely recommend Westwood Veterinary Clinic.
Super sweet staff that take great care of my Teddy!

I couldn’t recommend any other place for you to take your furry friend. The staff is very kind and helpful. Doctor Eduardo give you the best quality check out and comes personally at the front to talk to you. I had the best experience here. I rate 1000000. Thank u all for the best customer service and surgery on my little one. Benji sends love as well ♥️

I want to express my sincerest gratitude to the team at Westwood Veterinary Clinic in  Westchester for the outstanding care and attention they provided to my dog. I came to them on a friend's recommendation and couldn't be more satisfied.
My dog needed a dental procedure and blood work, and the team at Westwood Veterinary Clinic took care of everything with professionalism and kindness. They performed an oral surgery with intraoral X-rays, blood tests, and treated the periodontal disease she had.
What impressed me most was their transparency and education on my dog's health. They explained diseases I wasn't aware of, like heartworm, and did the necessary test. Fortunately, it was negative, and they started her on a preventive treatment.
I'm extremely satisfied with the service and care I received. The team at Westwood Veterinary Clinic is friendly, professional, and clearly passionate about what they do. I highly recommend them. They're the best!
The Dr. is exceptional. I have been taking my 12 years old chihuahua since she was a puppy. I love the attention and care we got every time. Totally recommend 🐶 …

Excelent experience.
I want to express my sincerest gratitude to Dr. Eduardo García and the team at Westwood Veterinary Clinic for the outstanding care and attention they provided to our dog Rocco. A friend recommended this clinic, and we couldn't be more thankful. Rocco had a lump on his ribs, and Dr. García recommended a biopsy. After a few days, we were informed it was a benign tumor. What impressed us most was the option Dr. García presented: cryosurgery, a painless, outpatient procedure with no anesthesia, which was also more cost-effective than traditional surgery.
Rocco's recovery was quick and satisfactory, just as Dr. García explained. It took about three weeks, and there were no issues. We're extremely grateful to Dr. García and his team for their professionalism, kindness, and dedication. If you need veterinary care, don't hesitate to take your pet to Westwood Veterinary Clinic in Westchester. They're the best!

I wasn’t sure where to go at first, but I ended up choosing Westwood Veterinary Clinic in Westchester and I’m glad I did. From the moment I walked in, everything felt organized and calm. The visit didn’t take long at all and they handled my dog with a lot of care. Really good experience overall.

I had an amazing experience at Westwood Veterinary Clinic in Westchester. The staff was super caring and attentive, and they handled everything efficiently. You can tell they really care about the animals. The whole visit was quick, easy, and overall really positive!

I took my dog to Westwood Veterinary Clinic in Westchester for a heartworm test and had such a great experience. The staff was super friendly and everything was done really quickly. They made the whole process smooth and stress-free, which I really appreciated. Definitely recommend this place if you’re in the Westchester area!

I just wanted to share my amazing experience with Westwood Veterinary Clinic! Dr. Garcia was absolutely fantastic with my dog's TPLO surgery. She took the time to explain every detail, answered all my questions, and presented me with options for care, including the use of Nocita, a local long-acting anesthesia. We opted for it and it made a huge difference in my dog's recovery.

The entire staff was incredibly helpful and supportive throughout the process. My dog's recuperation was exceptional, and I credit that to the excellent care we received at Westwood. From the vets to the techs, everyone was knowledgeable, kind, and compassionate.

If you're looking for a veterinary clinic that truly cares about your pet's well-being, look no further than Westwood Veterinary Clinic. I'll be taking my furry friend back there in a heartbeat! ‎

Thank you for the 5 stars, Cesar! 🌟 We're so glad you had a great experience with us. At Miami Springs Animal Hospital, we take pride in providing quality care and genuine compassion for every pet and their family. Hope to welcome you back soon! …

STAY AWAY! Disorganized, and they only seem to know how to serve one type of client: Hispanics. I brought my chihuahua in for a physical and a quote for dental cleaning, and the doctor said my dog had a heart murmur. He suggested an echocardiogram but said the cardiologist is mobile and has to come to the clinic.

They refused to schedule the appointment until I paid $700 on my debit card, explaining that they charge a large fee to use a credit card. They pressured me into this, and that is not customer-centered. I should be able to get a second opinion!! The front desk lady told me my appointment was at 5:00 PM. They close at 6:00 PM. I arrived at 5:00 PM, and no one said anything to me, so I waited until 6:00 PM, and the cardiologist still had not arrived.

After I got restless, I asked the front desk what was taking so long. They said the appointment was always at 5:45 PM and that I was wrong. It's their fault because nobody here speaks English, they told me to come an hour early for no reason, and their lazy cardiologist was running on 'Miami time' and would be arriving after they close at 6 PM. What a joke.

I now have to dispute the transaction with my bank because the doctor is arrogant, rude, and convinced he is always right. He became very defensive just because I asked questions about my dog’s care. He also said that if I sent prescription requests from Chewy, he would reject them until I paid PER MEDICATION. He even yelled from the back, loudly enough for me to hear at the front, that if I had a problem with that, I could find someone else to approve the prescription.

A friend recommended me this place, but since they are Hispanic, they have not had these issues and were also shocked at how much they were charging me for services and even suggested I keep looking. I will never be back!

I brought my puppy to Westwood Veterinary after purchasing him from a breeder who referred me there. The very next day after bringing my puppy home, he began showing symptoms, including vomiting, and I had to seek immediate veterinary care.

From the moment I arrived at Westwood Veterinary, I was treated with compassion, kindness, and professionalism. Dr. garcia was absolutely amazing, as was the entire staff. Everyone was supportive, attentive, and truly caring. A special thank you to Sara and other lady who was so kind and supportive throughout this incredibly difficult time.

My puppy, Kylo, battled parvo and was hospitalized for an entire week. The team at Westwood Veterinary did everything they possibly could to save him. While the outcome was heartbreaking and Kylo unfortunately passed away, I truly believe without a doubt that every effort was made to give him a fighting chance.

Dr. Garcia is an exceptional veterinarian. He is patient, knowledgeable, hardworking, and incredibly dedicated. He kept me informed every step of the way, worked after hours, and treated my puppy with the same care and love as if he were his own. When you see a doctor who genuinely tries with everything they have, it means the world especially during moments like these.

Although this experience ended in loss, I am deeply grateful for the care, effort, and compassion shown to my puppy and to me. I would recommend Westwood veterinary and Dr. Garcia to anyone and everyone, especially if your pet is sick and needs attentive, dedicated care. Thank you for trying so hard to save my baby. 🤍
Westwood veterinary and Dr. Garcia to anyone and everyone

They treated my cat with so much care and patience, making him feel comfortable and safe. I am very grateful for their excellent service and highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for dedicated and trustworthy veterinary care.
I just got a puppy and have been going to this place. So far the doctor and staff have been great 😊 …

They're scammers. I tried to get a prescription for Nexgard (the same medication they prescribed for my dog). very friendly and helpful! they genuinely care about your pet, treating them as their own!

My dog Snoop had bowel obstruction and required surgery. She was also dehydrated  from not eating/drinking. She had kidney issues  and infection. Thanks to excellent care of Dr. Eduardo Garcia and his wonderful staff at Westwood Vetenary clinic, she was able to come home.

I couldn’t be more grateful for the incredible care my dog and I received here. I walked in without an appointment, and the front office staff welcomed us right away. They didn’t hesitate to help and got us in immediately. Dr. Garcia, Gustavo, the manager, and the entire team were kind, thorough, and professional. They explained everything clearly, handled my dog with so much care, and kept me informed throughout her tests. I felt truly supported and reassured the entire time. Highly recommend this vet clinic, they go above and beyond!

They are Crooks. Sold me an annual plan. Came within the year and they told me dog wasn’t due for annual yet. Gave me appointment 1 month out then wanted to bill me double because my annual plan has expired and I didn’t renew in time. They knew this and that’s why they didn’t see him 1 month earlier. Bad Business!!!!! Stay away!!!!
Excellent service, we've been coming for over 6 years, very friendly, highly recommended

Pets bring so much joy, but they also require a lot of responsibility and care, and there's no better place for your pet's care than this. The team is excellent, very respectful and empathetic, but the real star of the show is their veterinarian, Dr. Eduardo. He's an excellent doctor who does his job with love, patience, and dedication. He always listens to what we have to say and takes the time to explain everything as many times as necessary. I wouldn't entrust my pet to any other veterinarian. I only have words of gratitude for him and the entire team. Highly recommended, and they even offer discounts and medical plans.

I have been going with Dr. Garcia since my dog was very sick and we couldn’t find the reason of her problems. Dr. Garcia was very knowledgeable and recommended the best treatment now Nina is in amazing shape and we can gratefully say that this place has taken care of our pet as their pet since that day. The staff is very friendly and helpful and I recommended 100%. Best pet clinic in Miami!!!

**Wow!** That was my first reaction when I watched Dr. Eduardo Garcia expertly examining our puppies. **Wow!** Again, as his medical staff handled our babies with such genuine care and warmth. **Wow!** At the ease of scheduling appointments—always at times that fit my schedule perfectly.

And the "wows" don’t stop there. Time after time, the entire team at Westwood Veterinary Clinic has gone above and beyond to fit us in when minor emergencies arise. Their dedication doesn’t end when the visit does—follow-up calls and texts after procedures and vaccinations remind me just how much they truly care.

Passion, expertise, experience, thoroughness, kindness, peace of mind, happiness, and trust—these are the words that come to mind when I think of Dr. Eduardo Garcia and his phenomenal staff at Westwood Veterinary Clinic on Bird Road and 109th Avenue, in Miami, FL 33165.

A place where you can feel the love for animals from the moment you walk in. The front desk staff are incredibly kind and attentive, and they explain everything in detail. The technician and the veterinarian were also amazing: attentive, professional, and very caring. You can see the commitment and dedication of the entire team. It's so reassuring to know our pets are in such good hands. Thank you for everything! Highly recommended!!! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
